create_cloud_build_client: create a Cloud Build Client with project, bucket, credentials, and optional kaniko and cache settings
build_docker_image: build a Docker image via Cloud Build from a local directory and return the image URI
upload_tar_to_storage: upload a tar archive to a GCS bucket for Cloud Build source input
test_build_request_body: test the _build_request_body method generates correct Docker build request with standard builder
test_build_request_body_use_kaniko: test the _build_request_body method generates correct Kaniko executor build request with cache settings
